title: feat(spec)!: retire page:header showStar — the follow star the reference console no longer draws
body:
Fixes #23650

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Regen-provenance: merge of origin/main at 46ca793edbef645731bebadb1bd7a63564cafba2 plus check:generated regeneration; no source change since the reviewed head 75ddc305dc.

## What

Retires `page:header` `showStar` (`PageHeaderProps`) through the spec-property-retirement route, per the maintainer's ruling on the card (record `6203775759`, letter A: 「A 退役 showStar (Recommended)」).

Since objectstack-ai/objectui#12427 the record chip draws the follow star only where the host wires `onToggleFavorite` into the record context, and no reference host does: the record's favorites entry is the header's ⋯ menu. So `showStar: true` (the default) drew nothing and `showStar: false` hid nothing.

| surface | change |
| --- | --- |
| `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` | `showStar` becomes a `retiredKey()` tombstone. The prescription names the header's ⋯ menu as the favorites entry and says metadata does not control it. `recordChrome`'s describe stops promising a star. |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` | D2 conversion `page-header-show-star-removed` (toMajor 18, `retiredFromLoadPath`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`, order 66). It strips both values from every `page:header` (region, nested `children`, slotted page slot) and is scoped by component type. |
| `migrations/entries/retired-keys/18.ui__PageHeaderProps__showStar.ts` | `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` entry |
| `migrations/entries/semantic/18.page-header-show-star-retired.ts` + `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 98) | ADR-0087 D3 entry |
| `packages/spec/liveness/page.json` | `[1] page:header` read-point list: `showStar` is now marked refused. `recordChrome` and `showCopyId` stay. |
| generated | `authorable-surface/ui.json` (`[RETIRED]`), `authorable-defaults/ui.json` (`showStar = true` removed), `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` |
| `.changeset/23650-page-header-show-star-retired.md` | `@objectstack/spec` minor, BREAKING, FROM → TO, ADR-0087 `registered` marker |

### Pins

- **New:** `packages/spec/src/ui/page-header-show-star-retirement.test.ts` (repo project, listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`). It covers:
  - the tombstone refuses `true`, `false` and `'no'` at the key with the prescription;
  - a not-unrecognized-keys control;
  - the type-level `never` (`@ts-expect-error`);
  - the page parse still accepts a stored header;
  - the D2 strip for stored and built rows, plus its type scope, idempotence and load-path retirement;
  - the ledger rows;
  - a tree-scoped absence pin over the radius the package already declares.
- **Replaced pins:** `component.test.ts`'s `#6776` block pinned `showStar` default `true`, accepted `false`, and refused `'no'`. Those pins are deleted together with the key. The tombstone refusal pin `refuses \`true\` AND \`false\` at the key, with the prescription` and `a non-boolean is refused by the same tombstone, at the key` replace them, and the block keeps pinning `recordChrome` / `showCopyId`.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.test.ts`: the `#6776` acceptance fixture drops `showStar`. A new case pins `component-props-invalid` + `error` + path + prescription for `true` and `false`.
- `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` JOIN row added. `page-header-breadcrumb-retirement.test.ts`'s exact `PageHeaderProps:*` ledger list now includes `showStar`.

## Measurements

- **Producers:** none. The search was a `git grep showStar` at `140238a47` over `examples/`, `packages/*/src`, `skills/` and `content/` (outside the spec's schema/tests, generated references and the historical `registry.ts.template` rationale). objectui at the pinned `f96f771140f1` has no producer in apps or examples either.
- **objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` (`f96f771140f1`), for the Console Pin Gate:**
  - No TYPE reference: no import of `PageHeaderProps` and no `z.infer` of it. `app-shell`'s `ConsolePageHeaderProps` is its own interface.
  - The reads are untyped `schema?.showStar` / `schema?.properties?.showStar` in `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` (around `:1581`-`:1584`), plus `RecordTitleChip`'s own React prop.
  - The Console Pin Gate runs objectui's `tsc` against objectui's installed `@objectstack/spec` (the `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST` hook only reaches vite). So no compile break is expected from this removal. The gate itself was not run locally.
- **objectui read points for the follow-up card (the seat files it):**
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` `:1580`-`:1584` (the read), `:2616` (passes `showStar` to the chip), `:2681` (the registration's `{ name: 'showStar', type: 'boolean' }` input);
  - `packages/components/src/custom/RecordTitleChip.tsx` `:45`/`:63`/`:134`;
  - the CONTROL pin `packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-star-host-toggle-12427.test.tsx` `:117`-`:120`;
  - ⚠️ `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` `:5787` lists `['page:header', 'showStar']` in `settledUpstream`. It asserts `specTopLevelKeys(type)` contains the key, and that set subtracts tombstones. That test reads objectui's installed spec, so it goes red there on the first spec bump that carries this retirement, not here. The forward direction also reds while the registration still publishes the input.
  - docs: `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx:49` and `content/docs/guide/layout.md:373`.
- **`sdui.manifest.json`:** still lists `showStar` as a renderer input. It is not edited by hand. `check-sdui-manifest` checks shape, tamper, staleness and pin correspondence, not spec parity, and it is green. No gate here compares manifest inputs against `ComponentPropsMap`. It updates on the pin bump after objectui drops the input.

The new pin file went red (6 tombstone cases), then was restored byte-identically to HEAD (blob `d3db276b1322`).
